items.answer: Sort the toys into groups by type, count each group, and the group with the biggest count is the most
hints: What does Chintu do with the mixed toys first?
Then what does he count?
Sort, ___, and the ___ count is the most.
Sort by type, count each group, and pick the biggest count.

items.prompt_en: A basket has: mango, apple, mango, mango, apple. How many mangoes?
items.prompt_hi: Ek tokri mein hai: aam, seb, aam, aam, seb. Kitne aam?
hints: Listen for each mango.
Count only mangoes.
Mango, mango, mango: ___.
3 mangoes.

workedExample.problem: The toy box has cars, dolls and balls mixed up. Which toy is there the most of?
steps: Sort the toys by type into three groups: cars, dolls, balls.
Count each group, touching each toy once: cars 4, dolls 2, balls 3.
Compare the counts: 4 is the biggest.
So there are the most cars.
fadedVersion: Sort the toys by ___ into three groups.
Count each group: cars ___, dolls ___, balls ___.

interestContexts: colours of kites at Makar Sankranti

skills.title: Draws or stacks one picture or block per item
Lines up rows from the same start with same-size pictures to compare
Reads a picture chart by counting pictures

expectations: Draw one picture for each thing — no more, no less
Start every row at the same line
Keep pictures the same size and spacing
Compare rows by counting pictures, not by how long a row looks

misconceptions.belief: Compares rows by how long they look even when pictures are drawn different sizes
signs: Picks the longer row as "more" without counting
Ignores big vs small pictures

diagnostic.prompt_en: A row of 4 big car pictures is longer than a row of 5 small doll pictures. Which has more?
diagnostic.prompt_hi: 4 badi gaadi ki tasveeron wali line, 5 chhoti gudiya ki tasveeron wali line se lambi hai. Kismein zyada hain?

options.text: The cars — the row is longer

remediation.representation: Redraw both rows on a grid with one square per picture
remediation.moveShape: Count both rows aloud, then redraw them same-size on the grid and compare again

misconceptions.belief: Draws a few pictures to "show" a group, without one picture per item
signs: Draws 3 balls for 6 balls
Draws one big picture with a label instead of one per item

diagnostic.prompt_en: There are 6 balls. Bholu drew 3 balls on the chart. Does his chart show how many balls there are?
diagnostic.prompt_hi: 6 ball hain. Bholu ne chart pe 3 ball banayi. Kya uska chart batata hai kitni ball hain?

options.text: No — he needs 6 pictures, one for each ball

remediation.representation: Line from each real ball to one picture on the chart
remediation.moveShape: Match each real item to one picture; any item without a picture is missing

items.prompt_en: There are 3 cars. Draw one car picture for each. How many pictures?
items.prompt_hi: 3 gaadiyaan hain. Har gaadi ke liye ek tasveer banao. Kitni tasveerein?
hints: One picture for each car.
How many cars?
___ cars, ___ pictures.
3 pictures.

items.prompt_en: A picture chart: the cars row has 4 pictures and the dolls row has 2. How many cars?
items.prompt_hi: Ek picture chart: gaadi wali line mein 4 tasveerein, gudiya wali mein 2. Kitni gaadiyaan?
hints: Look at the cars row only.
Count its pictures.
The cars row has ___.
4 cars.

items.prompt_en: Chart: balls 5, dolls 3. Which row has more?
items.prompt_hi: Chart: ball 5, gudiya 3. Kis line mein zyada hain?
hints: Compare 5 and 3.
Which is more?
5 is more, so ___.
The balls row — 5 is more than 3.

items.prompt_en: A row of 4 big car pictures is longer than a row of 5 small doll pictures. Which has more?
items.prompt_hi: 4 badi gaadi ki tasveeron wali line, 5 chhoti gudiya wali line se lambi hai. Kismein zyada hain?
hints: Count each row instead of looking at length.
Cars: 4. Dolls?
5 is more than ___.
The dolls — 5 is more than 4; the car pictures are just bigger.

items.prompt_en: I will draw the car pictures bigger than the doll pictures. Guess: could the car row look longer even if there are fewer cars?
items.prompt_hi: Main gaadi ki tasveerein gudiya se badi banaoongi. Guess karo: kya gaadi wali line lambi dikh sakti hai, chahe gaadiyaan kam hon?
items.answer: Yes — bigger pictures make a longer row, so we must count
hints: What happens to a row when each picture is bigger?
Does a longer row then mean more?
It may look longer, so we must ___.
Yes — bigger pictures stretch the row; only counting tells which has more.

items.prompt_en: Why should all the pictures be the same size and every row start at the same line?
items.prompt_hi: Saari tasveerein ek size ki aur har line ek hi jagah se shuru kyun honi chahiye?
items.answer: So that a longer row really means more things — it makes the comparison fair
hints: What goes wrong if one row uses big pictures?
What if one row starts further in?
Same size and same start make it ___.
So the longer row truly has more — the comparison is fair.

items.prompt_en: There are 6 balls in the box. Bholu drew 3 balls on the chart. What is wrong?
items.prompt_hi: Dabbe mein 6 ball hain. Bholu ne chart pe 3 ball banayi. Kya galat hai?
items.answer: He needs 6 pictures, one for each ball
hints: How many balls are in the box?
How many pictures should there be?
One picture per ball means ___ pictures.
Bholu needs 6 pictures — one for each ball — not 3.

items.prompt_en: Stack one block for each car. There are 4 cars. How many blocks tall is the stack?
items.prompt_hi: Har gaadi ke liye ek block rakho. 4 gaadiyaan hain. Stack kitne block ooncha hoga?
hints: One block per car.
How many cars?
___ cars means ___ blocks.
4 blocks tall.

items.prompt_en: A chart of rotis eaten: Papa 4, Mummy 3, you 2. Who ate the most?
items.prompt_hi: Khaayi gayi rotiyon ka chart: Papa 4, Mummy 3, tum 2. Sabse zyada kisne khaayi?
hints: Compare 4, 3 and 2.
Which is the biggest?
The biggest is 4, so ___.
Papa — 4 rotis.

items.prompt_en: A weather chart: sunny days 5, rainy days 2. Were there more sunny or rainy days, and how many more?
items.prompt_hi: Mausam ka chart: dhoop wale din 5, baarish wale din 2. Dhoop wale din zyada the ya baarish wale, aur kitne zyada?
hints: Which number is bigger, 5 or 2?
Now find how many more: 5 − 2.
Sunny days, ___ more.
Sunny days — 3 more than rainy days.

items.prompt_en: Teach Chintu how to make a picture chart of his toys.
items.prompt_hi: Chintu ko sikhao apne khilonon ka picture chart kaise banaye.
items.answer: Sort the toys, draw one same-size picture for each toy, start every row at the same line, then count and compare the rows
hints: What does he do with the toys first?
How many pictures for each toy, and what size?
One ___ per toy, same ___, same start line.
Sort, draw one same-size picture per toy, line rows up at the start, then count to compare.

items.prompt_en: Chart: kites 3, tops 5. Which is fewer?
items.prompt_hi: Chart: patang 3, lattu 5. Kaun kam hai?
hints: Compare 3 and 5.
Which is smaller?
3 is less, so ___.
Kites — 3 is fewer than 5.

items.prompt_en: Chart: cars 4, dolls 2, balls 3. How many more cars than dolls?
items.prompt_hi: Chart: gaadiyaan 4, gudiyaan 2, ball 3. Gudiyon se kitni zyada gaadiyaan?
hints: Look at the cars row and the dolls row.
Match each doll picture with a car picture.
2 more cars.

workedExample.problem: Make a picture chart for 4 cars and 2 dolls, and say which has more.
steps: Draw a start line on the left for both rows.
In the cars row draw one same-size picture for each car: 4 pictures.
In the dolls row draw one same-size picture for each doll: 2 pictures.
Count and compare: 4 is more than 2, so there are more cars — 2 more.
fadedVersion: Draw a ___ line for both rows.
Cars row: one picture per car, ___ pictures.
Dolls row: one picture per doll, ___ pictures.
4 is more than 2, so there are ___ more cars.
